status: new presentation decisions; gameplay remains proposed and not playtested
authority: Per-profile visual details are owned by this JSON; faction-matrix.md is a derived reading view. Mechanics are never owned here.
global_rules: A family is a reusable visual grammar, never a claim of common ancestry or mandatory allegiance.
Decorative palette swatches never replace semantic functional UI colors or encode a state alone.
All specific invented production assets, portrait details and effect treatments below are new presentation decisions anchored to current gameplay.
Portraits preserve identity cues; map figures stay small, target regions remain larger, and text stays in an interface layer.
Source-inspired does not imply a literal canonical building, outfit, social institution or historical coexistence.
